items.exampleEn: People have two lungs in their chest.
The skin is the largest organ of the body.
items.exampleZh: 皮膚是人體最大的器官。

items.exampleEn: My cousin wants to become a surgeon.
items.exampleZh: 我表親想成為外科醫師。

items.exampleEn: Bend your elbow slowly and then stretch your arm.
items.exampleZh: 慢慢彎曲手肘，再伸直手臂。

items.exampleEn: Some plants look pretty but are deadly.
items.exampleZh: 有些植物看起來漂亮，卻是致命的。

items.exampleEn: The bracelet was too big for her wrist.
items.exampleZh: 這個手環對她的手腕來說太大了。

items.exampleEn: She can type messages quickly with her thumbs.
items.exampleZh: 她用大拇指打訊息打得很快。

items.exampleEn: She has a small mark on her forehead.
items.exampleZh: 她額頭上有一個小記號。

items.sentenceEn: The surgeon explained the operation to my parents.
items.sentenceZh: 外科醫師向我爸媽說明手術。

items.audioEn: Show the stamp on your wrist to enter the concert again.
items.audioZh: 再次入場時，請出示手腕上的印章。
options: Get a new stamp at the door.

items.sentenceEn: Divers can hold air in their lungs for a long time.
items.sentenceZh: 潛水員可以在肺裡憋氣很久。

items.sentenceEn: Don't put your elbows on the table while you eat.
items.sentenceZh: 吃飯時不要把手肘放在桌上。

items.stemEn: I hit my ____ with the hammer while fixing the chair.
items.stemZh: 修椅子時我用鐵鎚敲到了大拇指。

items.stemEn: This snake is small, but its bite is ____.
items.stemZh: 這條蛇很小，但被牠咬到是致命的。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, our class visited a museum about the human body. We saw a large model of the lungs and other organs. A guide showed us how the wrist and elbow move. Then we tried to pick up small things without using our thumbs, and it was very hard. Later, a real surgeon talked about her job. She said she washes her hands for three minutes before each operation. At the end, everyone got a smiling face stamped on their forehead.
items.passageZh: 上星期天，我們班去參觀一座人體博物館。我們看到肺和其他器官的大模型。導覽員示範手腕和手肘怎麼活動。接著我們試著不用大拇指撿起小東西，結果非常難。後來，一位真正的外科醫師介紹她的工作。她說每次手術前都要洗手三分鐘。最後，每個人的額頭上都蓋了一個笑臉印章。

questions.questionZh: 外科醫師說她手術前會做什麼？
不用大拇指撿東西，結果怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 他打籃球時傷到了手肘。
referenceEn: He hurt his elbow while he was playing basketball.
He hurt his elbow playing basketball.
rubricZh: 時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 wrist 造一個句子，說說你手腕上戴的東西或手腕的狀況。
referenceEn: I always wear a watch on my wrist.
My wrist hurts after I type for a long time.
rubricZh: wrist 表示「手腕」，例如 on my wrist 等說法
說的是自己的習慣或經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）
